packets.title: How to Visit 15 European Cities for less than $350/£300 - Europe 1 month itinerary
packets.destination: 15 European cities: London, Paris, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Ghent, Leuven, Cologne, Berlin, Budapest, Venice, Milan, Bologna, Florence, Rome, Athens
packets.country: Multiple (UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Greece)
packets.summary: A priced 1-month Eurotrip across 15 cities (mid-September to mid-October 2024) with every intercity transport leg booked 2 months ahead via Skyscanner and Omio. Transport total: €286 (~£246/$313) using budget flights, Flixbus/BlaBlaCar buses and advance train tickets. Each city stop includes his personal hotel/hostel picks and top free-or-cheap things to do.

items.name: London to Paris (16 Sep 2024)
items.details: Via Vueling, booked via Skyscanner

items.name: Wombats City Hostel London
items.details: His favourite hostel in London; converted seaman's hostel with bar, courtyard, lockers, linen, welcome drink, Wi-Fi, city map

items.name: Paris to Amsterdam (18 Sep 2024)
items.details: BlaBlaCar bus via Omio; 7h56, departs 8:05 arrives 16:01. Quicker alternative named: Eurostar €35 (Paris Gare du Nord 8:25 to Amsterdam Centraal 11:53)

items.name: Les Piaules Hostel Paris
items.details: Favourite place to stay in Paris; also recommends Generator Paris as decent

items.name: Amsterdam to Rotterdam (20 Sep 2024)
items.details: BlaBlaCar bus via Omio; 55 min

items.name: Vishuisje
items.details: Herring stand: herring with pickles and onions

items.name: Rotterdam to Ghent (23 Sep 2024)
items.details: Flixbus; 2h55

items.name: Hostel Uppelink
items.details: Family-run hostel in the centre with canal views; helpful staff; free walking tours 10am and 1pm (English/Spanish); free beer tastings Tue/Thu 6pm

items.name: Ghent to Leuven (25 Sep 2024)
items.details: Flixbus; 2 hours

items.name: HI De Blauwput Hostel
items.details: Top pick; behind the train station; onsite bar, clean comfortable rooms, buffet breakfast included, friendly staff

items.name: Leuven to Cologne (27 Sep 2024)
items.details: Deutsche Bahn train via bahn.com

items.name: Die Wohngemeinschaft Cologne
items.details: Top pick for Cologne; alternative: Cologne Downtown Hostel

items.name: Cologne to Berlin (30 Sep 2024)
items.details: Deutsche Bahn via Omio

items.name: Circus Berlin Hostel
items.details: Pictured as his Berlin stay pick

items.name: Berlin to Budapest (2 Oct 2024)
items.details: Deutsche Bahn; 11h12

items.name: Wombats City Hostel Budapest
items.details: Full breakfast, free Wi-Fi, good location, welcoming staff, good common areas

items.name: Budapest to Venice (5 Oct 2024)
items.details: ÖBB Railjet via Omio; 12h10 with change in Vienna

items.name: Generator Venice
items.details: His pick for Venice on a budget

items.name: Venice to Milan (7 Oct 2024)
items.details: Trenitalia via Omio app

items.name: Ostello Bello Milan
items.details: Favourite place to stay in Milan; free Wi-Fi, cosy common room, Mediterranean-style breakfast on demand, ping pong, library; also Ostello Bello Grande Milan and Ostello Bello Lake Como named

items.name: Milan to Bologna (9 Oct 2024)
items.details: Trenitalia via Omio

items.name: Dopa Hostel Bologna
items.details: Recommended stay; 99% handmade furnishings in an old downtown building (only hostel in the area); modern spacious bathrooms; each bed has power outlet, curtain, light and coat hook

items.name: Bologna to Florence (11 Oct 2024)
items.details: Trenitalia via Omio app

items.name: Ostello Bello Florence
items.details: Top pick; onsite bar, lovely helpful staff, good breakfast, terrace, self-catering kitchen, events schedule; also Plus Florence named (restaurant, pools, Turkish bath, sauna, rooftop terrace, free Wi-Fi)

items.name: Florence to Rome (14 Oct 2024)
items.details: Italo via Omio app

items.name: The Beehive
items.details: Favourite budget stay in Rome; also The YellowSquare named (party hostel for younger flashpackers)

items.name: Rome to Athens (17 Oct 2024)
items.details: Ryanair via Skyscanner

items.name: City Circus Athens Hostel
items.details: One of Europe's coolest design hostels; fun place, restaurant, beautiful rooms

items.name: Kostas
items.details: Souvlaki served for 65 years, described as probably the best souvlaki in town

items.name: Trip transport grand total
items.details: All 14 intercity legs total €286 (~£246/$313); excludes luggage fees and airport-to-city-centre transfers; optional Naples add-on +€45 or Ancona ferry to Split/Zadar +€100; 2-month Eurail pass alternative (15 travel days) €394

packets.title: A 10-Day Itinerary Down Sweden's Coast
packets.destination: Northern Sweden: Luleå, Umeå, Örnsköldsvik, Skuleskogen National Park, Sundsvall, Uppsala
packets.summary: Nomadic Matt's off-the-beaten-path 10-day northern Sweden route, worked south down the coast from Luleå to Uppsala. He emphasizes doing the trip by car (train/bus possible), with named hotels, restaurants, hikes, and admission-free nature stops throughout.

items.name: Clarion Hotel Sense
items.details: Affordable hotel in town center; comfy rooms, big breakfast buffet, gym

items.name: Luleå Archipelago
items.details: Summer hotspot; beaches, sea kayaking, boating, hiking; popular islands Kluntarna, Brändöskär, Junkön, Småskär

items.name: Gammelstad Church Town
items.details: Over 400 red wooden cottages around a 15th-century church; glimpse of Sweden's rural past

items.name: Gammelstadsviken nature reserve
items.details: One of Sweden's best birdwatching spots; 80+ species, trails and a large freshwater lake

items.name: Norrbotten Museum
items.details: Small free museum on Sami culture and industrial heritage (note: reported closed until further notice)

items.name: Hiking around Luleå
items.details: Suggested hikes: Hertsöleden (easy, 8km), Fäbodaleden (intermediate, 10km), Vitån (challenging, 12km); hiking guide at Visit Luleå

items.name: Bistron
items.details: Harbor restaurant Matt particularly enjoyed

items.name: Hotell Björken
items.details: Next to the university, 5-minute drive to central station; stylish, modern, won't break the bank

items.name: Västerbottens Museum
items.details: Cultural and natural history of the Västerbotten region, plus open-air historic buildings

items.name: Guitars the Museum
items.details: One of the world's largest private guitar collections; guided tours recommended

items.name: Kulturväven
items.details: Cultural hub with concerts, art exhibitions, library, cinema

items.name: Umedalens Skulpturpark
items.details: Free outdoor sculpture park in meadows and forest

items.name: Strandpromenaden
items.details: Relaxing riverside walkway with benches and cafes; pretty at sunset

items.name: Bodegan and Eljest
items.details: Restaurant picks for eating out in Umeå

items.name: Facit Bar
items.details: Great spot for inventive drinks

items.name: Elite Hotel
items.details: Beautiful hotel on the harbor with huge delicious breakfast

items.name: FriluftsByn
items.details: Expansive campsite out of town with restaurant and bar; hotspot for campers and roadtrippers

items.name: High Coast Trail
items.details: 130km trail (5-7 days full), or hike sections; scenic mountains, rugged coastlines, forests

items.name: Kayaking
items.details: Calm waters; two-hour rental 300 SEK, tandem kayak 400 SEK

items.name: Gullviks havsbad
items.details: Best beach in the area; sandy beach with volleyball nets, food, BBQ area

items.name: Skuleskogen National Park
items.location: High Coast, 30 min south of Örnsköldsvik
items.details: 7,400-acre wilderness of birch/pine forest, marshes, granite mountains, Baltic shoreline; highlight is Slåttdalsskrevan rock crevice (200m long, 30m deep)

items.name: Lilla Hotellet
items.details: Affordable locally-owned three-star hotel; quiet, cozy breakfast nook

items.name: Kulturmagasinet
items.details: Cultural center in converted harbor warehouses: museum, library, art space

items.name: Norra Berget
items.details: Open-air museum and park on a hill with 40 historic buildings; good with kids

items.name: Himlabadet Water Park
items.details: Family-friendly indoor pools, saunas, slides, surfing simulator

items.name: Sidsjön Lake
items.details: Peaceful lake 10 min from city center; swim, fish, paddle, walk/cycle trails

items.name: Alnön Island
items.details: Bridge-connected island day trip: sandy beaches, volcanic geology, small villages, scenic drives

items.name: Uppsala City Hostel
items.details: Best hostel in the city per Matt; basic bunks, great location

items.name: Botanika Uppsala
items.details: Hotel next to Sweden's oldest botanical garden

items.name: Uppsala Cathedral (Domkyrkan)
items.details: Scandinavia's largest church; 13th-century Gothic, tombs of King Gustav Vasa and Carl Linnaeus

items.name: Gustavianum
items.details: Museum of Sweden's oldest university (1477) with Viking treasures

items.name: Uppsala Castle
items.details: Renaissance-era castle with museums and exhibitions

items.name: Botanical Garden & Linnaeus Garden
items.details: Sweden's largest botanical garden of its kind; Linnaeus's reconstructed 18th-century teaching garden

items.name: Gamla Uppsala
items.details: Viking burial mounds, museum, and pagan-era church; key political/spiritual site of the Viking Age

items.name: Carolina Rediviva Library
items.details: One of Scandinavia's largest research libraries; houses the Codex Argenteus

items.name: Rental car for northern Sweden
items.details: Trip best done by car; Skuleskogen has no public transport options; discovercars.com linked as rental resource

packets.title: How to Spend Two Weeks in South Africa, Zambia, and Botswana
packets.destination: Johannesburg, Kruger, Blyde River Canyon, Livingstone, Kasane, Cape Town
packets.summary: Oneika and her partner Liebling's own 14-day Southern Africa route: 2 days Johannesburg, 2 days Kruger safari, 1 day Blyde River Canyon, 4 days Livingstone (Zambia) and Kasane (Botswana), 5 days Cape Town. Named hotels, safari lodge, restaurants, and prices throughout; she hiked Table Mountain, swam at the edge of Victoria Falls, and did game drives in Sabi Sands and Chobe.

items.name: Constitution Hill

items.name: Apartheid Museum
items.details: An absolute MUST per Oneika

items.name: Soweto and Mandela House
items.details: Nelson Mandela's residence 1946-1962

items.name: Maboneng and Melrose Arch
items.details: Funky Maboneng neighbourhood of black creatives; swanky Melrose Arch gated community with cafes and restaurant patios

items.name: Protea Fire & Ice Melrose Arch

items.name: The Grillhouse

items.name: Safari game drives
items.details: Saw the Big Five on the very first drive; four drives total with varied wildlife

items.name: Blyde River Canyon Nature Reserve

items.name: Premier Hotel OR Tambo

items.details: Devil's Pool-style swim at the falls' edge

items.name: Victoria Falls Bridge jump
items.details: Bungee/jump from the Victoria Falls Bridge

items.details: 2-day, 1-night safari; Chobe known for huge elephant population

items.name: Livingstone Museum

items.name: Jollyboys Backpackers

items.name: Table Mountain hike
items.details: Hiked up the mountain

items.name: Robben Island Prison Museum

items.name: V&A Waterfront

items.name: Radisson Blu Le Vendome

items.name: Nelson's Eye, NV-80, Hussar
items.details: Top-rated steakhouses around the city

items.details: Cape Malay cuisine; mash-up of Southeast Asian and Indian flavours; great taste and hearty portions

packets.title: Itinerary for Two Weeks in Morocco
packets.summary: Kiersten Rich's full day-by-day plan for two weeks in Morocco: 4 nights in Marrakech (Riad Yasmine, La Mamounia), 2 nights glamping in the Sahara Desert, 1 night in the Skoura Valley Oasis, 2 nights in Essaouira, the overnight train to Tangier, 2 nights in Chefchaouen, 1 night in Fes and a final night in Casablanca. Every stop pairs named hotels and restaurants with the specific activities she did there, plus real transport legs and costs.

items.name: Fly into Marrakech Menara Airport
items.details: Fly into Marrakech to start the trip

items.name: Riad Yasmine
items.details: Gorgeous riad; two-night stay covering Days 1-2; described as one of Instagram's most famous hotels

items.name: NOMAD
items.details: Cool fusion restaurant for dinner on the first night; great food and an epic sunset view

items.name: Ben Youssef Madrasa and Bahia Palace
items.details: Both perfect for photo ops

items.name: Le Jardin
items.details: Green oasis in the middle of the city; perfect midday break; pop-up shop inside

items.name: Buy a local Maroc SIM card
items.details: Maroc SIM card: 40 dirham (~$4 USD) plus 100 dirham (~$10 USD) for 10GB of data

items.name: Shop Jemaa el Fna markets
items.details: Shopping at Jemaa el Fna - noted as overly touristy with aggressive vendors

items.name: La Mamounia
items.details: Famous luxury hotel for the last couple of nights in the city (Days 3-4); a place to unwind and indulge

items.name: Drive Marrakech to the Sahara Desert
items.details: Approx. 10-hour drive; driver booked through the desert camp

items.name: Sahara Desert Luxury Camp
items.details: Two unforgettable nights of glamping (Days 5-6); travel/driver included in the glamping package

items.name: Transfer from Sahara Desert Camp to Skoura Valley Oasis
items.details: 5-hour transfer in a 4x4 with the private driver from the desert camp

items.name: L'ma Lodge
items.details: One-night stay (Days 7-8)

items.name: Drive to Essaouira
items.details: Approx. 7-hour drive with the driver from the desert camp

items.name: Villa Maroc
items.details: Two-night stay (Days 8-9); book a massage and spend time in their hammam

items.name: Explore the Medina and souks
items.details: Endless souks - schedule time and budget for shopping

items.name: Stroll the port and fish market
items.details: Huge port with bright blue boats; head to the bustling fish market afterwards

items.name: Take a cooking class
items.details: Learn to make traditional Moroccan dishes; offered by Villa Maroc

items.name: La Licorne
items.details: Fine dining experience; try their tajin and couscous dishes

items.name: Taxi to Marrakech
items.details: Taxi to Marrakech paid approx. $90 USD

items.name: Overnight train from Marrakech to Tangier
items.details: Overnight train, one night; a great way to see the landscape between cities

items.name: Taxi to Chefchaouen
items.details: Just over two hours; $60 USD

items.name: Dar Baibou
items.details: Two-night stay (Days 11-13); quaint hotel with traditional Moroccan style and great amenities

items.name: Casa Perleta (alternative)
items.details: Alternative top-rated hotel with Andalusian style; very popular so book early; beignet stand right next door

items.name: Hike to the Spanish Mosque
items.details: Overlooking Chefchaouen; plan a couple of hours to hike up and explore the abandoned mosque

items.name: Le Lamp Magique at Aladins
items.details: Popular for classic lunch dishes and one of the prime places in Chefchaouen to watch the sunset; favourite shop nearby was La Botica de la Abuela Aladdin for homemade soaps

items.name: Taxi to Fes
items.details: Approx. 3.5 hours

items.name: Visit the tanneries
items.details: Very sensory tour of the famous leather tanneries (lots of strong smells); beautiful handmade leather pieces; best overhead view of the souk and tanneries from the stairs of Shop 64

items.name: Explore Al Attarine Madrasa
items.details: Educational institute in the heart of the medina; interesting history and intricate architecture; worth the quick tour

items.name: Dar Seffarine
items.details: Oldest hotel in the medina with just six guest rooms; intimate feel and a nice escape from the busy streets

items.name: Train to Casablanca
items.details: Less than four hours; $12 to $25 USD depending on seats

items.name: Mogador Marina
items.details: One-night stay (Days 14-15)

items.name: Rick's Cafe
items.details: A classic; they make a great Negroni

items.name: Visit the Hassan II Mosque
items.details: Incredible mosque sitting above the Atlantic Ocean, visible through one room's glass floor

items.name: Bennis Habous pastry shop
items.details: Located near the old medina; often considered one of the best pastry shops in the country; try the hornes des gazelles

items.name: Resto Zayna
items.details: Very traditional Moroccan experience and a taste of the country's traditional cuisine

items.name: Stroll through Parc de La Ligue Arabe
items.details: Peaceful area full of greenery; ideal spot for a walk

packets.title: The Perfect Two Week Itinerary For Your First Trip to Japan
